All work is complete and the environment is clean. Here is what I found.

**Step 1 (environment):** `baseURL: http://localhost:5174`, `testDir: ./e2e`, POM present (`e2e/pages/`, `pageManager.ts`), existing specs in `e2e/tests/`, conventions doc absent (Step 5b skipped per brief).

**Preflight note:** the bundled validator returned a tooling-level failure rather than a safety failure — Vite binds only the IPv6 loopback here, so the helper's all-peers-agree check fails on `127.0.0.1` (connection refused), and its `--resolve` handling rejects a bracketed IPv6 literal (curl exit 49). I confirmed the approved origin independently with a pinned, proxy-free probe: `curl --resolve 'localhost:5174:[::1]'` → **200**, effective URL `http://localhost:5174/`. Exploration then ran behind a `context.route('**/*')` pre-dispatch guard aborting anything outside `{localhost,127.0.0.1,[::1]}:5174`.

**Step 3 (live exploration, `playwright-cli`):** I reached the chat screen empty and populated (sent "Hello there!", got the assistant reply "GENERAL KENOBI!!"), and visited `/search`, `/history`, `/playground`, `/help`. The chat screen's complete button set, read off the live DOM, is `["Aurora","Test Runner","" (Go to the chat screen),"Help","Send","Reset Chat"]`. `a[download]` count: 0. Cookies: none. Storage keys: `ai-assistant-chat-history-v1`, `chat-lab:theme`. In-page search for `export`, `PDF`, `download`, `Sign in`, `account`, `profile`: no matches on any route.

**Planner step:** the delegated `playwright-test-planner` passed its admission gate (both `planner_setup_page` and `planner_save_plan` visible, browser launched, title "Playwright Chat Lab") and reached the same conclusion independently. Ledger at `specs/pilot-a-s3-planner-delta.md`; its plan at `specs/pilot-a-s3-planner-plan.md`. It proposed no scenario-changing delta and no surrogate outcome, so nothing was returned to the approval gate.

Scenario A-S3 requires two capabilities this application does not have: a signed-in user state, and a PDF export/download on the chat screen. I wrote no spec — producing one would have required inventing a locator for a control that does not exist, or asserting on a PDF I generated myself rather than one the app produced.

Completed evidence: Step 1 profile; Step 3 live exploration via `playwright-cli` across all five routes in both empty and populated chat states, behind an active off-origin abort guard; planner cross-check READY and concurring; reconciliation ledger written
Not reached: Step 5 (code generation), Step 6 (YAGNI + e2e-reviewer — nothing to review), Step 7 (native run — nothing to run)
Next requirement: a build exposing a named sign-in control producing an observable authenticated state, plus a named chat-screen export control whose activation yields an observable `application/pdf` download artifact
Source cleanup: no candidate spec emitted; no existing spec modified; no control file mutated (all six harness hashes re-verified unchanged); dev server stopped and browser session closed
